method: Public Blockscout v2 APIs (gnosis/eth/optimism.blockscout.com) and JSON-RPC eth_getLogs/eth_call (rpc.gnosischain.com, polygon.gateway.tenderly.co, mainnet.optimism.io, ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com). Likes decoded from calldata and resolved to artists with NiftyInk.inkInfoById. Buyers identified from the sender of each transaction that paid the artist via NiftyToken. 2026-10-16 depth pass: full histories of the artist (0x9410...), second address (0x14a1...) and royalty wallet (0x7e73...) on Polygon, Arbitrum and Ethereum from Etherscan v2 (txlist, txlistinternal, tokentx, tokennfttx, token1155tx); Optimism and Gnosis from Blockscout PRO; Base from base.blockscout.com v2; Zora from full-range eth_getLogs on rpc.zora.energy with the account nonce as a completeness check. Counterparty ENS names are reverse records confirmed by a forward lookup. Contract royalty settings are eth_call reads of royaltyInfo(0, 10000), primarySaleRecipient() and getDefaultRoyaltyInfo().
caveats: A wallet address is not proof of a person's identity.
Mints to 0xdead000000000000000042069420694206942069 are read as deliberate burns of unsold edition slots; the contract emits no burn event.
Values are xDAI (Gnosis) and are not converted.
Polygon now covers the full history of all three addresses (artist nonce 1,277; 1,286 transactions with received ones).
Zora history is rebuilt from logs plus the nonce; Zora has no working explorer API.
Token ids on the OpenSea shared storefront and on contracts created through it carry the creator address in the top 160 bits, so they are 77-digit numbers.
Values on non-Gnosis chains are in each chain's native unit (ETH, POL) and are not converted.

topLikedArtists.method: Likes by the artist (gnosis.likes) grouped by the liked ink's artist; display name and counts read from each artist's Nifty Ink page (Statistics tab) on 2026-10-16. 345 likes across 93 artists; ties at the 20th place are cut by address.

reasoning: 20 of the artist's contracts name it as the EIP-2981 royalty receiver (royaltyInfo), on arbitrum, base, ethereum, optimism, polygon (Manifold on Ethereum, thirdweb elsewhere). On the thirdweb ones primarySaleRecipient is the artist's main address, so primary sales go to the artist and resale royalties to this wallet.
It received the royalty share of 4 secondary sales of the artist's works, in the same transaction that paid the artist (Seaport splits on Optimism and Polygon, and a WETH sale on Polygon).

Its outgoing transfers go back to the artist: 2 direct transfers to 0x9410... (Optimism 2023-06-21, Polygon 2023-07-03); the rest is one 35 POL transfer to 0x84f3ac69... and a WETH swap through the Uniswap router on Polygon.
It has no other activity: nonce 0 on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Zora and Gnosis; nonce 1 on Optimism; five transactions on Polygon.

Contracts that do not name it: 7 name the artist's main address as royalty receiver instead (the Base contracts other than "nnxyz base", the Zora 1155, and Friends Of Country Air on Polygon), and the early Polygon contracts (abstract, pxlpop, nifty faces px, "nnxyz" 0x5cdf) report no receiver.
